result.title: Beyond Fixed Prompt Configuration: Alternating Policy Learning for Adaptive Topology-Based Prompting in Few-Shot Graph Learning
result.summary: Graph Prompt Learning (GPL) adapts frozen pre-trained graph models to few-shot graph tasks through a small set of trainable prompts that encode task-specific information. Topology-based prompting instantiates this idea by augmenting an input graph with new prompt nodes and edges, yielding promising performance. However, prompt content and propagation structure are coupled, making it difficult to assess their individual effects and learn compatible configurations. In this paper, we empirically analyze two challenges in learning adaptive policies for topology-based prompting: asymmetric performance effects and coupled configuration selection. We then propose TTPR, a two-stage reinforcement framework that alternately optimizes two policies to generate adaptive configurations, with each policy conditioned on configurations generated by the other fixed policy. These conditional updates separate policy evaluation while preserving configuration compatibility. Specifically, TTPR models an edge-level policy to construct connection patterns and optimizes it with Connection Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO) through group-wise comparisons of complete connection patterns. The other is a node-level policy that generates prompt-node schemes and is optimized with Incremental Node Proximal Policy Optimization (INPPO) through incremental prompt-count decisions and feature generation. Across diverse datasets and pre-training strategies, TTPR ranks first in 8/10 few-shot node classification settings and attains the highest average performance across graph classification benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究少样本图学习中的拓扑式提示，先实证分析提示内容与传播结构耦合导致的非对称性能效应与配置选择困难，再提出 TTPR 两阶段强化学习框架，用边级策略构建连接模式、节点级策略生成提示节点方案，两策略在对方固定条件下交替优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其以「固定一方策略」条件更新来解耦内容与结构的训练方式，以及 group-wise 相对策略优化做配置贡献比较的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容与传播结构分离、训练监督与贡献分配的设计。
